name: Blue Light Schedule
author: David JM
description: Applies a blue light filter on a daily window you choose, by driving hyprsunset with time-based colour-temperature profiles. Left-click the bar widget to set the start and stop times and the temperature; the schedule is written into ~/.config/hypr/hyprsunset.conf as a managed block, so it keeps working across shell restarts and while the shell is down.

barWidget.description: Shows whether the blue light filter is on right now and when it changes next. Left-click opens a panel with the start time, the stop time, the filter temperature and an enable switch. Backed by hyprsunset profiles in ~/.config/hypr/hyprsunset.conf.
